de caña de azúcar de America Latina

pages.title: Política de privacidad
pages.creator: angelcreativa4
pages.content:
Quiénes somos

Nuestra dirección de sitio web es: http://maryluzangel.ml/intagrosenfold.

Qué datos personales recopilamos y por qué lo recogemos

Comentarios

Cuando los visitantes dejan comentarios en el sitio recopilamos los datos mostrados en el formulario de comentarios, y también la dirección IP del visitante y la cadena del agente de usuario del navegador para ayudar a la detección de spam.

Se puede proporcionar una cadena anónima creada a partir de su dirección de correo electrónico (también denominada hash) al servicio gravatar para ver si la está utilizando. La política de privacidad del servicio Gravatar está disponible aquí: https://automattic.com/privacy/. Después de la aprobación de tu comentario, su imagen de perfil será visible para el público en el contexto de tu comentario.

Medios

Si subes imágenes al sitio web, debes evitar cargar imágenes con datos de ubicación incrustados (EXIF GPS). Los visitantes del sitio web pueden descargar y extraer los datos de la ubicación de las imágenes en el sitio Web.

Formularios de contacto

Cookies

Si deja un comentario en nuestro sitio, puedes optar por guardar tu nombre, dirección de correo electrónico y sitio web en cookies. Estos es para tu comodidad y no tengas que volver a rellenar tus datos cuando dejes otro comentario. Estas cookies tendrán un año de duración.

Si visitas nuestra página de Acceso, se instalará una cookie temporal para determinar si tu navegador acepta cookies. Esta cookie no contiene datos personales y se elimina al cerrar el navegador.

Cuando inicies sesión, se instalarán varias cookies para guardar tu información de acceso y opciones de visualización de pantalla. Las cookies de acceso permanecerán por dos días y las cookies de opciones de pantalla se guardarán por un año. Si seleccionas «Recuérdarme» en tu inicio de sesión, estas se guardarán por dos semanas. Si cierra la sesión de tu cuenta, las cookies de acceso se eliminarán.

Si editas o publicas un artículo se guardará una cookie adicional en tu navegador. Esta cookie no incluye datos personales y simplemente indica el ID del artículo que acabas de editar. Caduca después de 1 día.

Contenido incrustado de otros sitios web

Los artículos de este sitio pueden incluir contenido incrustado (por ejemplo, vídeos, imágenes, artículos, etc.). El contenido incrustado de otras webs se comporta exactamente de la misma manera que si el visitante hubiera visitado la otra web.

Estas web pueden recopilar datos sobre ti, utilizar cookies, incrustar un seguimiento adicional de terceros, y supervisar tu interacción con ese contenido incrustado, incluido el seguimiento de tu interacción con el contenido incrustado si tienes una cuenta y estás conectado a esa web.

Analítica

Con quién compartimos tus datos

Cuánto tiempo conservamos tus datos

Si dejas un comentario, el comentario y sus metadatos se conservan indefinidamente. Esto es para que podamos reconocer y aprobar automáticamente cualquier comentario de seguimiento en lugar de mantenerlos en una cola de moderación.

Para los usuarios que se registren en nuestro sitio web (si los hay), se almacenarán todos sus datos de información personal que proporcionen. Cualquier usuario puede ver, editar o eliminar su información personal cuando lo desee (a excepción del nombre de usuario que no se puede editar). Los administradores de sitios web, también pueden ver y editar dicha información.

Qué derechos tienes sobre tus datos

Si tienes una cuenta en este sitio, o ha dejado comentarios, puedes solicitar la exportación de un archivo con tus datos personales recopilados, incluyendo cualquier otro dato que nos haya proporcionado. También puede solicitar la eliminación de cualquier dato personal que guardemos sobre ti. Esto no incluye los datos que estamos obligados a consevar para fines administrativos, legales o de seguridad.

Dónde enviamos tus datos

Puede que los comentarios de los visitantes sean validados por un servicio automatico de detección de spam.

pages.title: Masonry Shop
pages.creator: angelcreativa4
pages.content:
[av_heading tag='h2' padding='10' heading='Masonry Shop Grid Example' color='' style='blockquote modern-quote modern-centered' custom_font='' size='' subheading_active='' subheading_size='10' custom_class='' admin_preview_bg=''][/av_heading]

[av_textblock size='' font_color='' color='' admin_preview_bg='']
Please note: The Masonry Shop is not suited for a shop with hundreds of products (in that case use the default shop) but if you only sell a handful of item and want to display them in a stylish way this might be the way to do it. The Masonry Shop has also some limitations that the "default shop" doesn't have. It can't be selected as default shop or shop archive. pages.title: About Us
pages.creator: angelcreativa4
pages.content:
Consultoría de Excelencia

Quienes Somos

Somos una empresa de consultoría, ingeniería y gestión de proyectos y servicios Agropecuarios. Nos caracterizamos por ser una empresa joven, dinámica, profesional e internacional, con una clara orientación a la consecución de objetivos y retos que nuestros clientes nos plantean. Estamos orgullosos de contar con un equipo multidisciplinario, con amplia experiencia en el sector, motivado y con un gran compromiso hacia la eficiencia y la calidad del trabajo, lo cual ofrece tanto a nuestros clientes como a nuestros proveedores la confianza suficiente para poder establecer colaboraciones a largo plazo.

Contamos con una amplia red de colaboradores expertos del sector, en los cuales nos apoyamos para asegurar la mejor respuesta a las necesidades de nuestros clientes. La calidad de los servicios que ofrecemos, junto con los principios que rigen nuestra empresa: eficiencia, flexibilidad y, ante todo profesionalismo, nos han convertido en una de las empresas de referencia en Consultoría e Ingeniería Agropecuaria.

Misión

CONSULTORIA DE EXCELENCIA S.A.S. es un holding agroindustrial Colombiano, enfocado en generar soluciones y agregar valor al agro, gracias a un modelo de negocios integral e innovador, que comprende asesoría de excelencia a nuestros agricultores por medio de profesionales altamente calificados y la elaboración de productos y servicios de calidad y de alta innovación tecnológica para nuestros clientes nacionales e internacionales.

Visión

Ser la compañía de consultoría empresarial del sector Agropecuario líder, elegida por nuestra innovación, soluciones, productos y servicios.

Valores

GARANTÍA DE CALIDAD

Capacidad de captar y satisfacer las expectativas del cliente, mediante accesibilidad y atención personalizada

ACTITUD POSITIVA

Reto efectivo y ambicioso ante la incertidumbre para comprometerse con los desafíos de negocio de nuestros clientes. Éste es un valor diferencial reconocido por nuestros clientes.

LIDERAZGO

Compromiso con el desarrollo de las personas y su motivación, mediante nuestra integridad personal y profesional.

ÉTICA PROFESIONAL

Reconocer los derechos de los individuos y valorar las cualidades de los demás, por encima de otras consideraciones.

INNOVACIÓN Y CREATIVIDAD

Basada en la generación, desarrollo de ideas y soluciones, que faciliten la consecución de elementos diferenciales competitivos.

ORIENTACIÓN A RESULTADOS

Mediante la visión, rentabilidad y objetivos de la organización, asumimos personalmente la responsabilidad en los resultados

Política de Sustentabilidad y/o Medioambiente:

Consultoría de Excelencia S.A.S. adquiere los siguientes compromisos respecto a la Sustentabilidad y/o Medioambiente:

1. Participar de consultorías y servicios que sean sustentables con el medioambiente.
2. Apoyar la toma de decisiones, a través de los estudios contratados, para la mitigación de los gases de efecto invernadero y la contaminación ambiental.
3. Ser parte activa de la generación de herramientas para la gestión ambiental, principalmente en cuanto a los aspectos de toma de decisiones sectoriales, empresariales y gubernamentales.
4 .Reducir, Reciclar, reutilizar y/o recuperar sus residuos.

Suscríbete y recibe información de calidad para el cuidado de tus cultivos.

<style>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   INTAGROS — ASESORÍAS AGROINDUSTRIALES PREMIUM
   Prefijo: iga-  |  Unidad 01
   v2.0 — código consolidado, bugs corregidos
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.iga-page * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.iga-page img { display: block; }
.wp-block-html, .entry-content > .wp-block-html, .entry-content {
  max-width: 100% !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important;
}

/* ── HERO ──────────────────────────────────── */
.iga-hero {
  position: relative;
  height: 100vh;
  min-height: 680px;
  max-height: 900px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
}
.iga-hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: url('https://www.intagros.com.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/01.jpeg');
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center 35%;
  transform: scale(1.06);
  transition: transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  will-change: transform;
}
.iga-hero-bg.iga-loaded { transform: scale(1); }
.iga-hero-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(to top, rgba(8,18,8,0.97) 0%, rgba(8,18,8,0.55) 45%, rgba(8,18,8,0.08) 100%),
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(8,18,8,0.65) 0%, transparent 65%);
  z-index: 1;
}
.iga-hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1320px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 2.5rem 5rem;
}
.iga-bc {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.iga-bc a { color: rgba(248,246,241,0.35); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; }
.iga-bc a:hover { color: #a3c585; text-decoration: none; }
.iga-bc-sep { color: rgba(248,246,241,0.2); }
.iga-bc strong { color: #a3c585; font-weight: 600; }

.iga-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,0.25);
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #a3c585;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.iga-badge-dot {
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  background: #a3c585;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: igaPulse 2s ease infinite;
}
@keyframes igaPulse {
  0%,100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: .4; transform: scale(.7); }
}
.iga-hero-inner h1 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
  line-height: .96;
  letter-spacing: -.04em;
  color: #f8f6f1;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  max-width: 860px;
}
.iga-hero-inner h1 em { font-style: normal; color: #a3c585; }
.iga-hero-foot {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.iga-hero-foot p {
  font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: rgba(248,246,241,0.55);
  max-width: 560px;
}
.iga-cta-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 1rem 2rem;
  background: #a3c585;
  color: #1a2e1a;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: .875rem;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.iga-cta-pill:hover { background: #f8f6f1; transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.35); color: #1a2e1a; text-decoration: none; }
.iga-cta-pill svg { transition: transform .3s; }
.iga-cta-pill:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); }
.iga-progress { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: rgba(163,197,133,.12); z-index: 3; }
.iga-progress-bar { height: 100%; width: 20%; background: linear-gradient(to right, #a3c585, #2d5a27); border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; }

.iga-hero-stats {
  position: absolute;
  right: 2.5rem; top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.12);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}
.iga-hero-stat {
  padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem;
  text-align: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.08);
  transition: background .3s;
}
.iga-hero-stat:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.iga-hero-stat:hover { background: rgba(163,197,133,.06); }
.iga-hero-stat strong {
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  letter-spacing: -.03em;
  color: #a3c585;
  line-height: 1;
}
.iga-hero-stat span {
  font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: .78rem;
  color: rgba(248,246,241,.35);
  display: block;
  margin-top: .3rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .iga-hero-stats { display: none; } }

/* ── STRIP ──────────────────────────────────── */
.iga-strip { background: #1a2e1a; padding: 2rem 2.5rem; width: 100vw; margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw); }
.iga-strip-inner {
  max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between;
}
.iga-strip-tag { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: .65rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a3c585; flex-shrink: 0; }
.iga-strip-items { display: flex; gap: 0; flex: 1; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.iga-strip-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding: .5rem 1.75rem; border-left: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.1); }
.iga-strip-item:first-child { border-left: none; }
.iga-strip-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(163,197,133,.1); border-radius: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.iga-strip-icon svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: #a3c585; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.iga-strip-text { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(248,246,241,.65); white-space: nowrap; }

/* ── EYEBROW GLOBAL ─────────────────────────── */
.iga-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: .65rem; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2d5a27; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}
.iga-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 24px; height: 1.5px; background: #2d5a27; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── INTRO EDITORIAL ─────────────────────────── */
.iga-intro {
  background: #f4f2ed;
  padding: 9rem 2.5rem;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.iga-intro::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; right: 0;
  width: 45%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(45,90,39,.04) 0%, rgba(163,197,133,.06) 100%);
  clip-path: polygon(15% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.iga-intro-inner { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.iga-intro-top {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr;
  gap: 5rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 5rem;
}
@media (max-width: 960px) { .iga-intro-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 3rem; } }

.iga-intro-visual { position: relative; }
.iga-intro-img-main {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(26,46,26,.18);
}
.iga-intro-img-main img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); display: block; }
.iga-intro-visual:hover .iga-intro-img-main img { transform: scale(1.04); }



.iga-intro-years {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1.75rem; left: -1.5rem;
  background: #1a2e1a;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  z-index: 3;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.12);
}
.iga-intro-years strong {
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 2.25rem;
  letter-spacing: -.05em;
  line-height: 1;
  color: #a3c585;
}
.iga-intro-years span {
  font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: .78rem;
  color: rgba(248,246,241,.4);
  line-height: 1.3;
  display: block;
  margin-top: .2rem;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) { .iga-intro-years { left: 1rem; } }

.iga-intro-depts {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 1.75rem; left: 1.75rem;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.95);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: .9rem 1.25rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem;
  z-index: 3;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.iga-intro-depts-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; background: rgba(26,46,26,.15); border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.iga-intro-depts-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: #1a2e1a; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.iga-intro-depts strong { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.4rem; letter-spacing: -.04em; color: #1a2e1a; line-height: 1; display: block; }
.iga-intro-depts span { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: .6rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(26,46,26,.6); display: block; }

.iga-intro-text h2 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 3.75rem);
  line-height: .97;
  letter-spacing: -.04em;
  color: #1a2e1a;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}
.iga-intro-text h2 em { font-style: normal; color: #2d5a27; }
.iga-intro-text p { font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.08rem; line-height: 1.85; color: #5a6e5a; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
.iga-intro-quote {
  border-left: 3px solid #a3c585;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  margin: 2rem 0;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.06);
  border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0;
}
.iga-intro-quote p { font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.7; color: #2d5a27; margin-bottom: 0 !important; }
.iga-intro-link {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 2rem;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em;
  color: #2d5a27; text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(45,90,39,.3); padding-bottom: 2px; transition: all .25s;
}
.iga-intro-link:hover { color: #1a2e1a; border-color: rgba(26,46,26,.4); gap: 12px; text-decoration: none; }

.iga-intro-pillars {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1.5px; background: rgba(26,46,26,.08);
  border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden;
}
@media (max-width: 768px) { .iga-intro-pillars { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.iga-intro-pillar {
  background: #fff; padding: 2.5rem 2.25rem;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  transition: all .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
}
.iga-intro-pillar:hover { background: #1a2e1a; transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 48px rgba(26,46,26,.15); z-index: 1; }
.iga-intro-pillar::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #a3c585, #2d5a27);
  transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .4s ease;
}
.iga-intro-pillar:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.iga-intro-pillar-num {
  position: absolute; bottom: -.5rem; right: 1rem;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 5rem;
  line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.08em; color: rgba(26,46,26,.04);
  pointer-events: none; transition: color .4s; user-select: none;
}
.iga-intro-pillar:hover .iga-intro-pillar-num { color: rgba(163,197,133,.08); }
.iga-intro-pillar-icon {
  width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 13px;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.12); border: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.15);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem; transition: all .3s;
}
.iga-intro-pillar:hover .iga-intro-pillar-icon { background: rgba(163,197,133,.18); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(163,197,133,.2); }
.iga-intro-pillar-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; stroke: #2d5a27; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: stroke .3s; }
.iga-intro-pillar:hover .iga-intro-pillar-icon svg { stroke: #a3c585; }
.iga-intro-pillar h4 { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; color: #1a2e1a; margin-bottom: .5rem; line-height: 1.25; transition: color .3s; }
.iga-intro-pillar:hover h4 { color: #f8f6f1; }
.iga-intro-pillar p { font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif; font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #7a8e7a; transition: color .3s; }
.iga-intro-pillar:hover p { color: rgba(248,246,241,.45); }

/* ── SERVICIOS CON IMAGEN ─────────────────────── */
.iga-services {
  background: #111a11;
  padding: 8rem 2.5rem;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.iga-services::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 0% 30%, rgba(45,90,39,.35) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 50% at 100% 80%, rgba(163,197,133,.03) 0%, transparent 55%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.iga-services::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(163,197,133,.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 30px 30px; pointer-events: none;
}
.iga-services-inner { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.iga-sec-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; margin-bottom: 4.5rem; align-items: end; }
@media (max-width: 768px) { .iga-sec-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.iga-services .iga-eyebrow { color: #a3c585; }
.iga-services .iga-eyebrow::before { background: #a3c585; }
.iga-sec-header h2 { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3.25rem); line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.03em; color: #f8f6f1; }
.iga-sec-header h2 em { font-style: normal; color: #a3c585; }
.iga-sec-header p { font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: rgba(248,246,241,.4); align-self: end; }

.iga-srv2-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: 380px 380px;
  gap: 10px;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .iga-srv2-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 320px); } }
@media (max-width: 600px)  { .iga-srv2-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: repeat(6, 280px); } }
.iga-srv2-card:nth-child(1) { grid-column: span 2; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .iga-srv2-card:nth-child(1) { grid-column: span 1; } }

.iga-srv2-card { position: relative; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; cursor: default; }
.iga-srv2-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-size: cover; background-position: center; transition: transform .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); will-change: transform; }
.iga-srv2-card:hover .iga-srv2-bg { transform: scale(1.08); }
.iga-srv2-card::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(5,14,5,0.96) 0%, rgba(5,14,5,0.5) 40%, rgba(5,14,5,0.1) 100%);
  z-index: 1; transition: background .4s;
}
.iga-srv2-card:hover::before {
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(5,18,5,0.97) 0%, rgba(5,18,5,0.75) 55%, rgba(5,18,5,0.25) 100%);
}
.iga-srv2-num-bg {
  position: absolute; top: 1.25rem; right: 1.5rem;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 5.5rem;
  line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.08em;
  color: rgba(163,197,133,.06); z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none; transition: color .4s; user-select: none;
}
.iga-srv2-card:hover .iga-srv2-num-bg { color: rgba(163,197,133,.13); }
.iga-srv2-content { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; padding: 2rem 2.25rem; z-index: 3; }
.iga-srv2-cat {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: .57rem; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a3c585;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.18);
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: .8rem;
}
.iga-srv2-cat-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; background: #a3c585; border-radius: 50%; animation: igaPulse 2s ease infinite; }
.iga-srv2-icon {
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.18);
  border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: .9rem; transition: all .3s; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.iga-srv2-card:hover .iga-srv2-icon { background: rgba(163,197,133,.2); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(163,197,133,.15); }
.iga-srv2-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; stroke: #a3c585; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.iga-srv2-content h3 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800;
  font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.8vw, 1.35rem);
  color: #f8f6f1; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin-bottom: .5rem;
}
.iga-srv2-card:nth-child(1) .iga-srv2-content h3 { font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2.2vw, 1.75rem); }
.iga-srv2-desc {
  font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.65; color: rgba(248,246,241,.55);
  max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0;
  transition: max-height .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), opacity .35s ease, margin .4s;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
.iga-srv2-card:hover .iga-srv2-desc { max-height: 130px; opacity: 1; margin-bottom: .9rem; }
.iga-srv2-subs {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem;
  max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0;
  transition: max-height .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), opacity .35s ease .1s;
}
.iga-srv2-card:hover .iga-srv2-subs { max-height: 60px; opacity: 1; }

<script>
(function(){
  var bg = document.getElementById('igaBg');
  if(bg){
    setTimeout(function(){ bg.classList.add('iga-loaded'); }, 80);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
      if(window.scrollY < window.innerHeight * 1.2){
        bg.style.transform = 'scale(1) translateY(' + (window.scrollY * 0.28) + 'px)';
      }
    }, { passive: true });
  }

  /* ── INTERSECTIONOBSERVER CORREGIDO ─────────────
     Selectores correctos: .iga-step2, .iga-sec-card
     (antes: .iga-step, .iga-sector-card — no existían)
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.style.opacity = '1';
        e.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        observer.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' });

  document.querySelectorAll(
    '.iga-srv2-card, .iga-step2, .iga-metric, .iga-sec-card, .iga-intro-pillar'
  ).forEach(function(el, i){
    el.style.opacity = '0';
    el.style.transform = 'translateY(28px)';
    el.style.transition =
      'opacity .6s ease ' + (i * 0.07) + 's, ' +
      'transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) ' + (i * 0.07) + 's';
    observer.observe(el);
  });
})();
</script>

<style>

(function(){
  var bg = document.getElementById('igbBg');
  if(bg){
    setTimeout(function(){ bg.classList.add('igb-loaded'); }, 80);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
      if(window.scrollY < window.innerHeight * 1.2){
        bg.style.transform = 'scale(1) translateY(' + (window.scrollY * 0.28) + 'px)';
      }
    }, { passive: true });
  }
  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.style.opacity = '1';
        e.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        observer.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });
  document.querySelectorAll('.igb-srv2-card, .igb-step2, .igb-metric, .igb-gal-item, .igb-intro-pillar').forEach(function(el, i){
    el.style.opacity = '0';
    el.style.transform = 'translateY(28px)';
    el.style.transition = 'opacity .6s ease ' + (i * 0.08) + 's, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) ' + (i * 0.08) + 's';
    observer.observe(el);
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- wp:html -->
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@300;400;600;700;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   INTAGROS v3 — BIOPUNK INDUSTRIAL
   "La tierra tiene circuitos. El campo tiene datos."
   Bebas Neue · Barlow Condensed · JetBrains Mono
   #020402 / #0d1a0d / #061206 / #00ff6a / #00c44f / #1aff7a
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

:root {
  --void:        #020402;
  --abyss:       #040a04;
  --deep:        #061206;
  --surface:     #0a1a0a;
  --lift:        #0f220f;
  --neon:        #00ff6a;
  --neon-mid:    #00c44f;
  --neon-dim:    #007a32;
  --neon-ghost:  rgba(0,255,106,0.06);
  --neon-glow:   rgba(0,255,106,0.18);
  --white:       #f5f5f0;
  --grey:        rgba(245,245,240,0.45);
  --grey-dim:    rgba(245,245,240,0.22);
  --mono:        'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  --display:     'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
  --body:        'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
}

.bpk * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.bpk img { display: block; }
.wp-block-html, .entry-content > .wp-block-html, .entry-content {
  max-width: 100% !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important;
}

/* ── SCANLINE GLOBAL ─── */
.bpk::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9000;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    0deg,
    transparent,
    transparent 2px,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 2px,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 4px
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ── CURSOR PERSONALIZADO ─── */
.bpk { cursor: crosshair; }
.bpk a, .bpk button { cursor: crosshair; }

/* ══════════ HERO ══════════ */
.bpk-hero {
  position: relative;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  height: 100vh;
  min-height: 700px;
  max-height: 980px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr auto;
  background: var(--void);
}

/* GIF como fondo real */
.bpk-hero-gif {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
}
.bpk-hero-gif img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center center;
  display: block;
}

/* Capas de composición sobre el GIF */
.bpk-hero-vignette {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at 50% 50%, transparent 20%, rgba(2,4,2,0.55) 100%),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(2,4,2,0.5) 0%, transparent 25%, transparent 55%, rgba(2,4,2,0.97) 100%),
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(2,4,2,0.7) 0%, transparent 40%);
}

/* Grid de líneas tipo HUD */
.bpk-hero-grid {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(0,255,106,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,255,106,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 80px 80px;
  animation: bpkGridDrift 20s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes bpkGridDrift {
  0%   { background-position: 0 0; }
  100% { background-position: 80px 80px; }
}

/* Contenido del hero */
.bpk-hero-content {
  position: relative; z-index: 4;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 0 3rem 4rem;
  max-width: 1400px;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  align-self: end;
}

/* Breadcrumb estilo terminal */
.bpk-terminal-path {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--neon-dim);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}
.bpk-terminal-path::before {
  content: '~/';
  color: var(--neon);
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.bpk-terminal-path span { color: var(--neon); }

/* Badge de estado */
.bpk-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--neon);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.bpk-status-led {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  background: var(--neon);
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,255,106,0.2), 0 0 16px var(--neon);
  animation: bpkLed 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
@keyframes bpkLed {
  0%,100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,255,106,0.2), 0 0 16px var(--neon); }
  50%      { opacity: 0.5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,255,106,0.1), 0 0 6px var(--neon); }
}

/* Título hero — BRUTAL */
.bpk-hero-h1 {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(5rem, 12vw, 14rem);
  line-height: 0.88;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--white);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.15em;
}
.bpk-hero-h1 .bpk-accent {
  color: transparent;
  -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--neon);
  text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,255,106,0.4);
  display: block;
}
.bpk-hero-h1 .bpk-solid { display: block; }

/* Footer del hero — split layout */
.bpk-hero-foot {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 2.5rem;
  padding-top: 2rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.12);
}
.bpk-hero-desc {
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--grey);
  max-width: 500px;
}

/* Stats inline */
.bpk-hero-kpi {
  text-align: center;
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.1);
  padding-left: 2rem;
}
.bpk-hero-kpi strong {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 2.8rem;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--neon);
  text-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(0,255,106,0.4);
}
.bpk-hero-kpi span {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--grey-dim);
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
}

/* Botón CTA — brutalista */
.bpk-btn-primary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 1rem 2.25rem;
  background: var(--neon);
  color: var(--void);
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
  border: none;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 12px) 0, 100% 12px, 100% 100%, 12px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 12px));
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.bpk-btn-primary::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: var(--white);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
}
.bpk-btn-primary:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
.bpk-btn-primary span, .bpk-btn-primary svg { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.bpk-btn-primary:hover { color: var(--void); text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,255,106,0.35); }

/* Barra inferior del hero — HUD */
.bpk-hero-hud {
  position: relative; z-index: 4;
  width: 100%;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.08);
  padding: 0.75rem 3rem;
  max-width: 1400px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2rem;
  align-self: end;
}
.bpk-hud-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  color: var(--grey-dim);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.bpk-hud-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; background: var(--neon-dim); border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
.bpk-hud-sep { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: rgba(0,255,106,0.1); flex-shrink: 0; }
.bpk-hud-bar {
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0,255,106,0.15), transparent);
}

/* Número de versión top-right */
.bpk-hero-ver {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2rem; right: 3rem;
  z-index: 5;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  color: rgba(0,255,106,0.3);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ══════════ STRIP MARQUEE ══════════ */
.bpk-marquee-wrap {
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  background: var(--neon);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0.6rem 0;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.3);
}
.bpk-marquee-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  animation: bpkMarquee 22s linear infinite;
  width: max-content;
}
@keyframes bpkMarquee {
  0%   { transform: translateX(0); }
  100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}
.bpk-marquee-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  padding: 0 2.5rem;
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--void);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(2,4,2,0.15);
}
.bpk-marquee-item svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: var(--void); fill: none; stroke-width: 2.5; opacity: 0.7; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ══════════ SECCIÓN: WHY ══════════ */
.bpk-why {
  background: var(--abyss);
  padding: 8rem 3rem;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
/* Elemento decorativo — número grande de fondo */
.bpk-why::before {
  content: 'DATA';
  position: absolute;
  right: -2rem; bottom: -4rem;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 22rem;
  color: rgba(0,255,106,0.02);
  line-height: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
  letter-spacing: -0.05em;
}
.bpk-why-inner {
  max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
  gap: 7rem;
  align-items: center;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) { .bpk-why-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 4rem; } }

/* Columna izquierda — visual stack */
.bpk-why-visual { position: relative; }
.bpk-why-img-main {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 3/4;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 92% 0, 100% 8%, 100% 100%, 8% 100%, 0 92%);
}
.bpk-why-img-main img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  filter: saturate(0.5) brightness(0.7);
  transition: filter 0.6s ease;
}
.bpk-why-visual:hover .bpk-why-img-main img { filter: saturate(0.65) brightness(0.8); }

/* Overlay de color neón sobre la imagen */
.bpk-why-img-main::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,255,106,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%);
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
}

.bpk-why-img-secondary {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -3rem; right: -3rem;
  width: 55%;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 88%, 88% 100%, 0 100%);
  border: 2px solid var(--deep);
  box-shadow: -8px 8px 0 var(--neon-dim);
}
.bpk-why-img-secondary img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  filter: saturate(0.4) brightness(0.65);
}

/* Badge flotante */
.bpk-why-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2rem; left: -1.5rem;
  background: var(--void);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.2);
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 80%, 80% 100%, 0 100%);
  z-index: 3;
}
.bpk-why-badge strong {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  color: var(--neon);
  line-height: 1;
  text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,106,0.4);
}
.bpk-why-badge span {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  color: var(--grey-dim);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}

/* Badge bottom */
.bpk-why-badge2 {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -1rem; left: 2rem;
  background: var(--neon);
  padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 12px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 12px));
  z-index: 4;
}
.bpk-why-badge2 strong { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--void); line-height: 1; }
.bpk-why-badge2 span { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.55rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(2,4,2,0.6); }

/* Columna derecha — texto */
.bpk-section-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--neon);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.bpk-section-label::before { content: '//'; opacity: 0.5; }

.bpk-why-h2 {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 5.5vw, 6.5rem);
  line-height: 0.9;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--white);
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}
.bpk-why-h2 em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: transparent;
  -webkit-text-stroke: 1.5px var(--neon);
}

.bpk-why-p {
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--grey);
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.bpk-blockquote {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--neon);
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  margin: 2rem 0;
  background: var(--neon-ghost);
}
.bpk-blockquote p {
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--neon);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* Pilares — horizontal cards */
.bpk-pillars {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1px;
  background: rgba(0,255,106,0.06);
  margin-top: 5rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.06);
}
@media (max-width: 768px) { .bpk-pillars { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.bpk-pillar {
  background: var(--abyss);
  padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: background 0.4s;
}
.bpk-pillar:hover { background: var(--deep); }
.bpk-pillar::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px;
  background: var(--neon);
  transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--neon);
}
.bpk-pillar:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
.bpk-pillar-num {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 5rem;
  color: rgba(0,255,106,0.04);
  line-height: 1;
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -1rem; right: 1rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: color 0.4s;
  user-select: none;
}
.bpk-pillar:hover .bpk-pillar-num { color: rgba(0,255,106,0.08); }
.bpk-pillar-icon {
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  background: var(--neon-ghost);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.15);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 88% 0, 100% 12%, 100% 100%, 12% 100%, 0 88%);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.bpk-pillar:hover .bpk-pillar-icon { background: rgba(0,255,106,0.14); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,106,0.15); }
.bpk-pillar-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; stroke: var(--neon); fill: none; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.bpk-pillar h4 { font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.bpk-pillar p { font-family: var(--body); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--grey-dim); }

/* ══════════ SERVICIOS ══════════ */
.bpk-services {
  background: var(--void);
  padding: 8rem 3rem;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.bpk-services::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,255,106,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 40px 40px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.bpk-services-inner { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; z-index: 1; }

.bpk-sec-head {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 3rem;
  align-items: end;
  margin-bottom: 4rem;
  padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.08);
}
@media (max-width: 768px) { .bpk-sec-head { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.bpk-sec-h2 {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 6rem);
  line-height: 0.9;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--white);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.bpk-sec-h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--neon); text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,255,106,0.35); }
.bpk-sec-sub {
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--grey-dim);
  align-self: end;
}

/* Grid de servicios — asimétrico */
.bpk-srv-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 420px 420px;
  gap: 6px;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) { .bpk-srv-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: repeat(4, 300px); } }
.bpk-srv-card:nth-child(1) { grid-row: span 2; }
@media (max-width: 900px) { .bpk-srv-card:nth-child(1) { grid-row: span 1; } }

.bpk-srv-card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--deep);
  cursor: default;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 16px), calc(100% - 16px) 100%, 0 100%);
}
.bpk-srv-bg {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-size: cover; background-position: center;
  filter: brightness(0.3) saturate(0.4);
  transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), filter 0.5s;
}
.bpk-srv-card:hover .bpk-srv-bg { transform: scale(1.07); filter: brightness(0.38) saturate(0.5); }

/* Overlay escaneo verde */
.bpk-srv-scan {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, rgba(0,255,106,0.04) 50%, transparent 100%);
  animation: bpkScan 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes bpkScan {
  0%,100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-100%); }
  50%      { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(100%); }
}
.bpk-srv-card:hover .bpk-srv-scan { animation-duration: 2s; }

.bpk-srv-card::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(2,4,2,0.97) 0%, rgba(2,4,2,0.5) 45%, rgba(2,4,2,0.1) 100%);
  transition: background 0.4s;
}
.bpk-srv-card:hover::before { background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(2,4,2,0.99) 0%, rgba(2,4,2,0.72) 60%, rgba(2,4,2,0.2) 100%); }

.bpk-srv-num {
  position: absolute; top: 1.5rem; right: 1.5rem; z-index: 3;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 6rem;
  color: rgba(0,255,106,0.05);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.05em;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: color 0.4s;
  user-select: none;
}
.bpk-srv-card:hover .bpk-srv-num { color: rgba(0,255,106,0.1); }

.bpk-srv-content { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; padding: 2rem 2.25rem; z-index: 4; }
.bpk-srv-tag {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--neon);
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.bpk-srv-tag::before { content: '▸'; font-size: 0.5rem; }
.bpk-srv-icon {
  width: 42px; height: 42px;
  background: rgba(0,255,106,0.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.15);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 88% 0, 100% 12%, 100% 100%, 12% 100%, 0 88%);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.bpk-srv-card:hover .bpk-srv-icon { background: rgba(0,255,106,0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(0,255,106,0.15); }
.bpk-srv-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: var(--neon); fill: none; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.bpk-srv-content h3 {
  font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  color: var(--white); line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}
.bpk-srv-card:nth-child(1) .bpk-srv-content h3 { font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.5vw, 2rem); }
.bpk-srv-desc {
  font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 300; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.65;
  color: rgba(245,245,240,0.42);
  max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0;
  transition: max-height 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 0.35s ease, margin 0.4s;
}
.bpk-srv-card:hover .bpk-srv-desc { max-height: 120px; opacity: 1; margin-top: 0.6rem; }
.bpk-srv-chips {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem;
  max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0;
  transition: max-height 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 0.35s ease 0.1s;
}
.bpk-srv-card:hover .bpk-srv-chips { max-height: 50px; opacity: 1; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.bpk-srv-chip {
  font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.5rem; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--neon-dim); background: rgba(0,255,106,0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.1);
  padding: 2px 8px;
}

/* Línea inferior en hover */
.bpk-srv-card::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; z-index: 5;
  background: var(--neon);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--neon), 0 0 32px rgba(0,255,106,0.4);
  transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
}
.bpk-srv-card:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

/* ══════════ MÉTRICAS ══════════ */
.bpk-metrics {
  background: var(--deep);
  padding: 7rem 3rem;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.06);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.06);
}
.bpk-metrics::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 50%, rgba(0,255,106,0.03) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.bpk-metrics-inner {
  max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 3fr;
  gap: 6rem;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) { .bpk-metrics-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 3rem; } }
.bpk-metrics-text h2 {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 4.5vw, 5.5rem);
  line-height: 0.9;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--white);
}
.bpk-metrics-text h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--neon); display: block; }
.bpk-metrics-text p {
  font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 300; font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.8; color: var(--grey-dim); margin-top: 1.5rem;
}
.bpk-metrics-link {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 2rem;
  font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.65rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--neon); text-decoration: none;
  transition: gap 0.25s;
}
.bpk-metrics-link:hover { gap: 14px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--neon); }

.bpk-metrics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1px;
  background: rgba(0,255,106,0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.06);
}
@media (max-width: 700px) { .bpk-metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); } }
.bpk-metric {
  background: var(--deep);
  padding: 2.5rem 1.75rem;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: background 0.3s;
}
.bpk-metric:hover { background: rgba(0,255,106,0.03); }
.bpk-metric::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px;
  background: var(--neon);
  transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--neon);
}
.bpk-metric:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
.bpk-metric-val {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 3.75rem;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--neon);
  display: block;
  text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,255,106,0.3);
}
.bpk-metric-lbl {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--grey-dim);
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

/* ══════════ PROCESO ══════════ */
.bpk-process {
  background: var(--abyss);
  padding: 8rem 3rem;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.bpk-process::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,255,106,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 36px 36px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.bpk-process-inner { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.bpk-process-head { margin-bottom: 5rem; }
.bpk-process-head h2 {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 6rem);
  line-height: 0.9;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--white);
}
.bpk-process-head h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--neon); }

.bpk-steps {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1px;
  background: rgba(0,255,106,0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.05);
}
@media (max-width: 900px) { .bpk-steps { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); } }
@media (max-width: 480px)  { .bpk-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

.bpk-step {
  background: var(--abyss);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 460px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  transition: background 0.4s;
}
.bpk-step:hover { background: var(--deep); }

/* Imagen del paso */
.bpk-step-img {
  height: 200px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.bpk-step-img-bg {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-size: cover; background-position: center;
  filter: brightness(0.3) saturate(0.4) hue-rotate(80deg);
  transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), filter 0.5s;
}
.bpk-step:hover .bpk-step-img-bg { transform: scale(1.08); filter: brightness(0.38) saturate(0.5) hue-rotate(60deg); }
.bpk-step-img::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 30%, rgba(2,4,2,0.95) 100%);
  z-index: 1;
}
.bpk-step-fase {
  position: absolute; top: 1rem; left: 1rem; z-index: 2;
  font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.55rem; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--neon); background: rgba(2,4,2,0.8);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.2); padding: 4px 10px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.bpk-step-bignum {
  position: absolute; bottom: 0.5rem; right: 1rem; z-index: 2;
  font-family: var(--display); font-size: 5rem;
  color: rgba(0,255,106,0.12); line-height: 1;
  pointer-events: none; user-select: none;
  transition: color 0.4s;
}
.bpk-step:hover .bpk-step-bignum { color: rgba(0,255,106,0.22); }

/* Body del paso */
.bpk-step-body {
  padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem 2rem;
  flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.04);
  position: relative;
}
.bpk-step-body::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--neon) 0%, transparent 100%);
  transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: top;
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
  box-shadow: 2px 0 10px rgba(0,255,106,0.3);
}
.bpk-step:hover .bpk-step-body::after { transform: scaleY(1); }

.bpk-step-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem; }
.bpk-step-icon {
  width: 38px; height: 38px;
  background: var(--neon-ghost);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.12);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 88% 0, 100% 12%, 100% 100%, 12% 100%, 0 88%);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.bpk-step:hover .bpk-step-icon { background: rgba(0,255,106,0.14); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,255,106,0.15); }
.bpk-step-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; stroke: var(--neon); fill: none; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.bpk-step-body h4 { font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--white); line-height: 1.2; }
.bpk-step-body p { font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 300; font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.75; color: rgba(245,245,240,0.3); flex: 1; transition: color 0.3s; }
.bpk-step:hover .bpk-step-body p { color: rgba(245,245,240,0.5); }
.bpk-step-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 0.5rem; }
.bpk-step-tag {
  font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.5rem; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(0,255,106,0.45); background: rgba(0,255,106,0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,106,0.08); padding: 2px 7px;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.bpk-step:hover .bpk-step-tag { color: var(--neon-dim); background: rgba(0,255,106,0.08); border-color: rgba(0,255,106,0.14); }

/* ══════════ GALERÍA ══════════ */
.bpk-gallery {
  background: var(--void);
  padding: 8rem 3rem;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.bpk-gallery-inner { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; }
.bpk-gallery-head { margin-bottom: 3rem; }
.bpk-gallery-head h2 { font-family: var(--display); font-size: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 6rem); line-height: 0.9; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--white); }
.bpk-gallery-head h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--neon); }

.bpk-gal-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 280px 280px;
  gap: 6px;
}
@media (max-width: 768px) { .bpk-gal-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows: 200px 200px 200px; } }
@media (max-width: 480px)  { .bpk-gal-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 220px); } }

.bpk-gal-item {
  overflow: hidden; position: relative;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%);
}
.bpk-gal-item:first-child { grid-row: 1/3; }
.bpk-gal-item img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), filter 0.5s;
  filter: brightness(0.45) saturate(0.4);
}
.bpk-gal-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.07); filter: brightness(0.55) saturate(0.55); }
.bpk-gal-overlay {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(2,4,2,0.95) 0%, rgba(2,4,2,0.2) 55%, transparent 100%);
  transition: background 0.4s;
}
.bpk-gal-item:hover .bpk-gal-overlay { background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(2,4,2,0.97) 0%, rgba(2,4,2,0.55) 65%, rgba(2,4,2,0.1) 100%); }
/* Scanline verde en hover */
.bpk-gal-item::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; z-index: 3;
  background: var(--neon);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--neon);
  top: -2px;
  transition: top 0s;
  opacity: 0;

pages.content:
<!-- wp:html -->
<style>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   INTAGROS — LOGÍSTICA E INFRAESTRUCTURA PREMIUM
   Prefijo: igd-  |  Unidad 04
   Paleta: #1a2e1a / #2d5a27 / #a3c585 / #f8f6f1
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.igd-page * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.igd-page img { display: block; }

.wp-block-html,
.entry-content > .wp-block-html,
.entry-content {
  max-width: 100% !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* ── HERO ──────────────────────────────────── */
.igd-hero {
  position: relative;
  height: 100vh;
  min-height: 680px;
  max-height: 900px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
}

.igd-hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: url('https://www.intagros.com.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/33.jpeg');
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center 45%;
  transform: scale(1.06);
  transition: transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  will-change: transform;
}
.igd-hero-bg.igd-loaded { transform: scale(1); }

.igd-hero-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(to top,  rgba(6,12,20,0.97) 0%, rgba(6,12,20,0.58) 45%, rgba(6,12,20,0.1) 100%),
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(6,12,20,0.7) 0%, transparent 65%);
  z-index: 1;
}

.igd-hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1320px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 2.5rem 5rem;
}

/* Breadcrumb */
.igd-bc {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.igd-bc a { color: rgba(248,246,241,0.35); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; }
.igd-bc a:hover { color: #a3c585; text-decoration: none; }
.igd-bc-sep { color: rgba(248,246,241,0.2); }
.igd-bc strong { color: #a3c585; font-weight: 600; }

/* Badge */
.igd-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,0.25);
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #a3c585;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.igd-badge-dot {
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  background: #a3c585;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: igdPulse 2s ease infinite;
}
@keyframes igdPulse {
  0%,100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: .4; transform: scale(.7); }
}

/* Headline */
.igd-hero-inner h1 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
  line-height: .96;
  letter-spacing: -.04em;
  color: #f8f6f1;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  max-width: 860px;
}
.igd-hero-inner h1 em { font-style: normal; color: #a3c585; }

.igd-hero-foot {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.igd-hero-foot p {
  font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: rgba(248,246,241,0.55);
  max-width: 560px;
}

.igd-cta-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 1rem 2rem;
  background: #a3c585;
  color: #1a2e1a;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: .875rem;
  letter-spacing: .01em;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.igd-cta-pill:hover { background: #f8f6f1; transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.35); color: #1a2e1a; text-decoration: none; }
.igd-cta-pill svg { transition: transform .3s; }
.igd-cta-pill:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); }

.igd-progress {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.12);
  z-index: 3;
}
.igd-progress-bar {
  height: 100%;
  width: 80%;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #a3c585, #2d5a27);
  border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;
}

/* Stats laterales */
.igd-hero-stats {
  position: absolute;
  right: 2.5rem;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.12);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}
.igd-hero-stat {
  padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem;
  text-align: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.08);
  transition: background .3s;
}
.igd-hero-stat:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.igd-hero-stat:hover { background: rgba(163,197,133,.06); }
.igd-hero-stat strong {
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  letter-spacing: -.03em;
  color: #a3c585;
  line-height: 1;
}
.igd-hero-stat span {
  font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: .78rem;
  color: rgba(248,246,241,.35);
  display: block;
  margin-top: .3rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .igd-hero-stats { display: none; } }

/* ── STRIP ──────────────────────────────────── */
.igd-strip {
  background: #0f1a10;
  padding: 2rem 2.5rem;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
}
.igd-strip-inner {
  max-width: 1320px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.igd-strip-tag {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: .65rem;
  letter-spacing: .2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #a3c585;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.igd-strip-items { display: flex; gap: 0; flex: 1; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.igd-strip-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .75rem;
  padding: .5rem 1.75rem;
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.1);
}
.igd-strip-item:first-child { border-left: none; }
.igd-strip-icon {
  width: 28px; height: 28px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.1);
  border-radius: 6px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.igd-strip-icon svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: #a3c585; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.igd-strip-text { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(248,246,241,.6); white-space: nowrap; }

/* ── SERVICIOS PRINCIPALES ──────────────────── */
.igd-services {
  background: #f4f2ed;
  padding: 8rem 2.5rem;
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
}
.igd-services-inner { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; }

.igd-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: .65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #2d5a27;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}
.igd-eyebrow::before {
  content: '';
  width: 24px; height: 1.5px;
  background: #2d5a27;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.igd-sec-header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 3rem;
  margin-bottom: 4.5rem;
  align-items: end;
}
@media (max-width: 768px) { .igd-sec-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

.igd-sec-header h2 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3.25rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
  letter-spacing: -.03em;
  color: #1a2e1a;
}
.igd-sec-header h2 em { font-style: normal; color: #2d5a27; }
.igd-sec-header p {
  font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: #5a6e5a;
  align-self: end;
}

/* Grid 3 cards principales */
.igd-srv-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) { .igd-srv-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
@media (min-width: 560px) and (max-width: 900px) { .igd-srv-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }

.igd-srv-card {
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(26,46,26,.06);
  transition: all .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.igd-srv-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 24px 56px rgba(26,46,26,.11); }

.igd-srv-card-top {
  padding: 2.25rem;
  background: #1a2e1a;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 160px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.igd-srv-card-top::before {

.igd-srv-card-top::after {

.igd-srv-num {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: .62rem;
  letter-spacing: .18em;
  color: rgba(163,197,133,.3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.igd-srv-icon {
  width: 52px; height: 52px;
  background: rgba(163,197,133,.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163,197,133,.16);
  border-radius: 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: background .3s;
}
.igd-srv-card:hover .igd-srv-icon { background: rgba(163,197,133,.2); }
.igd-srv-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; stroke: #a3c585; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

.igd-srv-card-body { padding: 2rem 2.25rem 2.25rem; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
.igd-srv-card-body h3 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.1rem;

}
.igd-srv-card-body p {
  font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: .95rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: #5a6e5a;
  flex: 1;
}
.igd-srv-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; }
.igd-srv-tag {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: .58rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;

  background: rgba(45,90,39,.06);

/* ── INMOBILIARIA FEATURED ──────────────────── */

          <p>Intermediación especializada en compraventa de fincas productivas, predios con vocación agrícola y terrenos para proyectos agroindustriales. Avalúos técnicos, estudio de títulos y acompañamiento notarial completo.</p>

            <span class="igd-srv-tag">Compraventa</span>
            <span class="igd-srv-tag">Avalúo técnico</span>
            <span class="igd-srv-tag">Títulos</span>

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ════ INMOBILIARIA FEATURED ════ -->
<section class="igd-inmob">
  <div class="igd-inmob-inner">
    <div>
      <div class="igd-eyebrow">Inmobiliaria Agrícola</div>
      <h2>Su próxima finca<br>productiva está<br><em>aquí</em></h2>
      <p>Contamos con un portafolio activo de predios rurales en las principales zonas agropecuarias del país. Cada propiedad ha sido evaluada técnica y legalmente por nuestro equipo especializado.</p>
      <p>Asesoramos tanto a compradores que buscan invertir en el agro como a vendedores que necesitan valorar y comercializar correctamente sus activos rurales.</p>
      <a href="#igd-contacto" class="igd-inmob-link">
        Ver predios disponibles
        <svg width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>

    </div>
    <div class="igd-inmob-features">
      <div class="igd-inmob-feat">
        <div class="igd-inmob-feat-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4M7.835 4.697a3.42 3.42 0 001.946-.806 3.42 3.42 0 014.438 0 3.42 3.42 0 001.946.806 3.42 3.42 0 013.138 3.138 3.42 3.42 0 00.806 1.946 3.42 3.42 0 010 4.438 3.42 3.42 0 00-.806 1.946 3.42 3.42 0 01-3.138 3.138 3.42 3.42 0 00-1.946.806 3.42 3.42 0 01-4.438 0 3.42 3.42 0 00-1.946-.806 3.42 3.42 0 01-3.138-3.138 3.42 3.42 0 00-.806-1.946 3.42 3.42 0 010-4.438 3.42 3.42 0 00.806-1.946 3.42 3.42 0 013.138-3.138z"/></svg>
        </div>
        <div class="igd-inmob-feat-body">
          <h4>Avalúo Técnico Especializado</h4>
          <p>Valoración de predios con metodología agronómica: capacidad productiva, vocación del suelo, infraestructura existente y potencial de desarrollo.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="igd-inmob-feat">
        <div class="igd-inmob-feat-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8z"/><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/><line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"/><line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"/><polyline points="10 9 9 9 8 9"/></svg>

        <div class="igd-inmob-feat-body">
          <h4>Estudio de Títulos y Saneamiento</h4>
          <p>Verificación jurídica completa del predio, gestión de saneamiento de títulos, sucesiones y procesos de englobe o desenglobe ante notaría y registro.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="igd-inmob-feat">
        <div class="igd-inmob-feat-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M21 10c0 7-9 13-9 13s-9-6-9-13a9 9 0 0118 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg>
        </div>
        <div class="igd-inmob-feat-body">
          <h4>Portafolio en Zonas Estratégicas</h4>
          <p>Predios disponibles en Llanos Orientales, Eje Cafetero, Valle del Cauca, Costa Atlántica y Magdalena Medio, las regiones de mayor dinamismo agroindustrial.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="igd-inmob-feat">
        <div class="igd-inmob-feat-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="12" y1="1" x2="12" y2="23"/><path d="M17 5H9.5a3.5 3.5 0 000 7h5a3.5 3.5 0 010 7H6"/></svg>
        </div>
        <div class="igd-inmob-feat-body">
          <h4>Financiamiento y Crédito Rural</h4>
          <p>Articulación con Banco Agrario, FINAGRO y fondos de inversión para estructurar esquemas de financiamiento adaptados a la compra de activos rurales productivos.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ════ PROCESO ════ -->
<section class="igd-process">
  <div class="igd-process-inner">
    <div class="igd-eyebrow">Metodología</div>
    <h2 style="font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(2rem,3.5vw,3.25rem);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.05;color:#1a2e1a;margin-bottom:0;">Cómo entregamos <em style="font-style:normal;color:#2d5a27;">nuestras soluciones</em></h2>

      <div class="igd-step">
        <div class="igd-step-num-wrap"><span>02</span></div>
        <h4>Propuesta Técnica y Comercial</h4>

      </div>

        <div class="igd-step-num-wrap"><span>03</span></div>

      <div class="igd-step">
        <div class="igd-step-num-wrap"><span>04</span></div>
        <h4>Soporte y Seguimiento</h4>

<!-- ════ MÉTRICAS ════ -->
<section class="igd-metrics">

      <h2>Infraestructura que<br>soporta el <em>agro nacional</em></h2>
      <p>Nuestra red logística cubre las principales zonas productivas del país, con capacidad de respuesta rápida y estándares de calidad verificados en cada entrega.</p>
      <p>Más de 200 operaciones agropecuarias confían en INTAGROS para gestionar sus necesidades de combustible, infraestructura vial y activos inmobiliarios rurales.</p>
      <a href="#igd-contacto" class="igd-metrics-link">

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ════ GALERÍA ════ -->
<section class="igd-gallery">
  <div class="igd-gallery-inner">

      </div>

      <div class="igd-gal-item">

        <div class="igd-gal-caption">Predios en portafolio</div>
      </div>

</section>

<!-- ════ CTA ════ -->
<section class="igd-cta" id="igd-contacto">
  <div class="igd-cta-word">LOGÍSTICA</div>
  <div class="igd-cta-inner">
    <div>
      <h2>¿Necesita combustible,<br>vías o una <em>finca productiva</em>?</h2>
      <p>Cuéntenos su necesidad y le diseñamos una solución logística a la medida de su operación.<br>Respondemos en menos de 24 horas hábiles.</p>

<script>
(function(){
  var bg = document.getElementById('igdBg');
  if(bg){
    setTimeout(function(){ bg.classList.add('igd-loaded'); }, 80);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
      if(window.scrollY < window.innerHeight * 1.2){
        bg.style.transform = 'scale(1) translateY(' + (window.scrollY * 0.28) + 'px)';
      }
    }, { passive: true });
  }

  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.style.opacity = '1';
        e.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        observer.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });

  document.querySelectorAll('.igd-srv-card, .igd-step, .igd-metric, .igd-inmob-feat').forEach(function(el, i){
    el.style.opacity = '0';
    el.style.transform = 'translateY(28px)';
    el.style.transition = 'opacity .6s ease ' + (i * 0.07) + 's, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) ' + (i * 0.07) + 's';
    observer.observe(el);
  });
})();
</script>
