pages.content:
<!-- wp:html -->
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;600;700;800;900&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,600;1,300;1,500&family=Crimson+Pro:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400;1,600&display=swap');

.ica * { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0; }
.ica img { display:block; }
.wp-block-html,.entry-content>.wp-block-html,.entry-content {
  max-width:100%!important; padding:0!important; margin:0!important;
}

/* ════ HERO ════ */
.ica-hero {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:56% 44%;
  min-height:100vh; width:100vw; margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);
  background:#060b03; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
@media(max-width:900px){ .ica-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

.ica-hero-left {
  background:#060b03;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between;
  padding:3rem 4.5rem 4rem; position:relative; z-index:2; overflow:hidden;
}
.ica-hero-left::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; width:700px; height:700px; border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(42,97,36,.18) 0%,transparent 65%);
  left:-250px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); pointer-events:none;
}
.ica-hero-left::after {
  content:''; position:absolute; right:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#c88b0c 25%,#e6ac2e 50%,#c88b0c 80%,transparent);
}
.ica-canas-art {
  position:absolute; right:-20px; top:0; bottom:0; width:360px;
  pointer-events:none; z-index:1; opacity:.12;
}
.ica-hero-right { position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:#0a1906; }
@media(max-width:900px){ .ica-hero-right{height:62vw;} }
.ica-hero-right img {
  width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; opacity:.78;
  transition:transform 1.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
}
.ica-hero-right:hover img { transform:scale(1.05); }
.ica-hero-right::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:1;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(6,11,3,.7) 0%,transparent 55%),
             linear-gradient(to top,rgba(6,11,3,.6) 0%,transparent 40%);
}
.ica-bc {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-size:.58rem; font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(230,172,46,.3);
}
.ica-bc a { color:rgba(230,172,46,.3); text-decoration:none; }
.ica-bc a:hover { color:#e6ac2e; }
.ica-bc span { color:rgba(230,172,46,.14); }
.ica-hero-eyebrow {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-top:1.5rem;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-size:.58rem; font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(62,126,46,.5);
}
.ica-hero-eyebrow::before {
  content:''; width:18px; height:2px; background:#2a6124; display:block;
  box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(42,97,36,.38),0 8px 0 rgba(42,97,36,.2),0 12px 0 rgba(42,97,36,.1);
}
.ica-hero-title { flex:1; display:flex; align-items:center; padding:1.5rem 0; position:relative; }
.ica-titulo-stack {
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.06em; line-height:.84;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:relative; z-index:2;
}
.ica-t-cana {
  font-size:clamp(5rem,10.5vw,11.5rem);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f2cc6a 0%,#e6ac2e 22%,#c88b0c 52%,#3e7e2e 80%,#2a6124 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
  display:block; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 55px rgba(200,139,12,.32));
}
.ica-t-de {
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.8vw,3rem); font-style:italic; font-weight:300;
  color:rgba(248,242,224,.16); -webkit-text-fill-color:rgba(248,242,224,.16);
  display:block; letter-spacing:.04em;
}
.ica-t-azucar {
  font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5.5vw,6rem);
  -webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(230,172,46,.28); color:transparent;
  -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; display:block; letter-spacing:-.04em;
}
.ica-t-panela {
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-weight:700;
  font-size:clamp(.85rem,1.6vw,1.4rem); letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(248,242,224,.14); -webkit-text-fill-color:rgba(248,242,224,.14);
  display:block; margin-top:.9rem;
}
.ica-hero-bottom {
  display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between; gap:2rem; flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.ica-hero-desc {
  font-family:'Crimson Pro',Georgia,serif; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.82;
  color:rgba(248,242,224,.3); max-width:340px;
}
.ica-pill {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px;
  padding:.88rem 2.1rem; background:#c88b0c; color:#060b03;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.78rem;
  border-radius:999px; text-decoration:none; transition:all .3s; flex-shrink:0;
}
.ica-pill:hover { background:#e6ac2e; transform:translateY(-2px); color:#060b03; text-decoration:none; }
.ica-pill svg { transition:transform .25s; }
.ica-pill:hover svg { transform:translateX(3px); }
.ica-hero-img-label {
  position:absolute; bottom:2rem; left:2rem; z-index:2; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px;
}
.ica-hero-img-label span {
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-size:.54rem; font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(248,242,224,.28);
}
.ica-hero-img-label strong {
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif; font-style:italic; font-size:.95rem; color:rgba(248,242,224,.55);
}

/* ════ NUMERALIA ════ */
.ica-nums {
  background:#0a1906; width:100vw; margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);
  padding:4.5rem 4rem; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  position:relative; overflow:hidden; border-top:2px solid rgba(200,139,12,.18);
}
.ica-nums::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#c88b0c 25%,#e6ac2e 50%,#c88b0c 75%,transparent);
}
@media(max-width:768px){ .ica-nums{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);padding:3.5rem 2rem;} }
.ica-num-item { padding:2rem 2.5rem; border-right:1px solid rgba(200,139,12,.08); transition:background .3s; }
.ica-num-item:last-child { border-right:none; }
.ica-num-item:hover { background:rgba(200,139,12,.04); }
.ica-num-val {
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-weight:900;
  font-size:clamp(3rem,5.5vw,5rem); line-height:.88; letter-spacing:-.07em; color:#f0e8d0; display:block;
}
.ica-num-val em { color:#e6ac2e; font-style:normal; }
.ica-num-unit {
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-size:.56rem; font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(200,139,12,.3); display:block; margin-top:.65rem;
}

/* ════ MANIFIESTO ════ */
.ica-manifest {
  background:#0f2008; width:100vw; margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);
  padding:10rem 4rem; text-align:center; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.ica-manifest-bg {
  position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-weight:900;
  font-size:clamp(7rem,17vw,17rem); line-height:1; letter-spacing:-.09em;
  color:rgba(42,97,36,.06); pointer-events:none; user-select:none; white-space:nowrap;
}
.ica-manifest-cana-l,.ica-manifest-cana-r {
  position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; width:200px; opacity:.07; pointer-events:none;
}
.ica-manifest-cana-l { left:-40px; }
.ica-manifest-cana-r { right:-40px; transform:scaleX(-1); }
.ica-manifest-inner { max-width:880px; margin:0 auto; position:relative; z-index:1; }
.ica-manifest-label {
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif; font-size:.6rem; font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.26em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#c88b0c; display:block; margin-bottom:2.5rem;
}
.ica-manifest-quote {
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,3.4rem); line-height:1.28;
  color:rgba(248,242,224,.88); font-style:italic; margin-bottom:4rem;
}

<script>
(function(){
  /* Parallax hero */
  var img = document.getElementById('icaHeroImg');
  if(img){
    window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
      if(window.scrollY < window.innerHeight){
        img.style.transform='scale(1) translateY('+(window.scrollY*.14)+'px)';
      }
    },{passive:true});
  }

  /* Scroll reveal */
  var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.style.opacity='1'; e.target.style.transform='translateY(0)'; obs.unobserve(e.target); }
    });
  },{threshold:.04,rootMargin:'0px 0px -25px 0px'});
  document.querySelectorAll('.ica-paso,.ica-var,.ica-svc,.ica-num-item,.ica-manifest-col p,.ica-gal-item').forEach(function(el,i){
    el.style.opacity='0'; el.style.transform='translateY(22px)';
    el.style.transition='opacity .62s ease '+(i*.04)+'s,transform .65s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) '+(i*.04)+'s';
    obs.observe(el);
  });

  /* Barras Brix */
  var brixObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.querySelectorAll('.ica-brix-fill').forEach(function(f){
          setTimeout(function(){f.style.width=f.getAttribute('data-width')||'80%';},200);
        });
        brixObs.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  },{threshold:.2});
  document.querySelectorAll('.ica-var').forEach(function(v){brixObs.observe(v);});

  /* Videos reveal */
  var vObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.style.opacity='1'; e.target.style.transform='translateY(0)'; vObs.unobserve(e.target); }
    });
  },{threshold:.06});
  document.querySelectorAll('.ica-vid-main,.ica-vid-sec,.ica-vid-text-panel').forEach(function(el,i){
    el.style.opacity='0'; el.style.transform='translateY(28px)';
    el.style.transition='opacity .7s ease '+(i*.15)+'s,transform .75s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) '+(i*.15)+'s';
    vObs.observe(el);
  });

  /* Controles de video */
  function setupVideo(videoId,wrapId,playBtnId,pauseBtnId,muteBtnId,fsBtnId,progBarId,progFillId,durId){
    var vid=document.getElementById(videoId), wrap=document.getElementById(wrapId),
        play=document.getElementById(playBtnId), pause=document.getElementById(pauseBtnId),
        mute=document.getElementById(muteBtnId), fs=document.getElementById(fsBtnId),
        prog=document.getElementById(progBarId), fill=document.getElementById(progFillId),
        dur=document.getElementById(durId);
    if(!vid||!wrap) return;
    function fmtTime(s){ var m=Math.floor(s/60),ss=Math.floor(s%60); return m+':'+(ss<10?'0':'')+ss; }
    vid.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',function(){ if(dur) dur.textContent=fmtTime(vid.duration); });
    function togglePlay(){
      if(vid.paused){
        document.querySelectorAll('.ica-vid-wrap video').forEach(function(v){ if(v!==vid&&!v.paused){ v.pause(); v.closest('.ica-vid-wrap').classList.remove('playing'); } });
        vid.play(); wrap.classList.add('playing');
      } else { vid.pause(); wrap.classList.remove('playing'); }
    }
    if(play) play.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();togglePlay();});
    if(pause) pause.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();togglePlay();});
    vid.addEventListener('click',togglePlay);
    vid.addEventListener('timeupdate',function(){ if(vid.duration&&fill) fill.style.width=(vid.currentTime/vid.duration*100)+'%'; });
    if(prog) prog.addEventListener('click',function(e){ var r=prog.getBoundingClientRect(); vid.currentTime=((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*vid.duration; });
    vid.addEventListener('ended',function(){ wrap.classList.remove('playing'); if(fill) fill.style.width='0%'; });
    var muted=false;
    if(mute) mute.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); muted=!muted; vid.muted=muted; mute.style.opacity=muted?'.4':'1'; });
    if(fs) fs.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); if(vid.requestFullscreen) vid.requestFullscreen(); else if(vid.webkitRequestFullscreen) vid.webkitRequestFullscreen(); });
  }
  setupVideo('icaVideoMain','icaVidMain','icaPlayMain','icaPauseMain','icaMuteMain','icaFsMain','icaProgMain','icaProgFillMain','icaDurMain');
  setupVideo('icaVideoSec','icaVidSec','icaPlaySec','icaPauseSec','icaMuteSec','icaFsSec','icaProgSec','icaProgFillSec','icaDurSec');
})();
</script>

    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.style.opacity = '1';
        e.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        observer.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.06, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

  document.querySelectorAll('.ift-esp, .ift-svc, .ift-num-item, .ift-feat, .ift-manifest-cols > p').forEach(function(el, i){
    el.style.opacity = '0';
    el.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
    el.style.transition = 'opacity .55s ease ' + (i * 0.05) + 's, transform .55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) ' + (i * 0.05) + 's';
    observer.observe(el);
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   INTAGROS — FLORICULTURA

     Rosa fuerte        #c23462   Rosa medio     #d9608a

<style>

  max-width: 100% !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important;
}

/* ════════════════════════════
   HERO — EL INVERNADERO
════════════════════════════ */
.ifl-hero {

/* Resplandor ambiental rosa */
.ifl-hero-left::before {
  content: '';

    linear-gradient(to top, rgba(6,8,16,.55) 0%, transparent 45%);

/* ── Breadcrumb ── */
.ifl-bc {

/* ── TÍTULO — LETRAS QUE FLORECEN ── */
.ifl-hero-title {

/* Arte SVG botánico en el hero */

}

.ifl-titulo-stack {

}

/* "FLORI" — gradiente del tallo (verde raíz → rosa cima) */
.ifl-t-flori {

  font-size: clamp(5.5rem, 11vw, 12rem);

    #d9608a 22%,

/* "COLOMBIANA" pequeño caps */
.ifl-t-sub {

/* ── BOTTOM HERO ── */
.ifl-hero-bottom {

/* Etiqueta foto hero */
.ifl-hero-img-label {

}

/* ════════════════════════════

.ifl-nums {

/* ════════════════════════════

.ifl-proceso {

/* ── PASO DE PROCESO ── */

/* ════════════════════════════
   ESPECIES / VARIEDADES
   Sobre fondo oscuro — la noche del invernadero
════════════════════════════ */
.ifl-especies {
  background: #060810;
  width: 100vw; margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);

}

/* Arte floral fondo — rosas esquemáticas SVG */

<script>
(function(){
  /* ── Parallax hero ── */
  var img = document.getElementById('iflHeroImg');
  if(img){
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
      if(window.scrollY < window.innerHeight){
        img.style.transform = 'scale(1) translateY(' + (window.scrollY * 0.13) + 'px)';
      }
    }, { passive:true });
  }

  /* ── Scroll reveal ── */
  var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.style.opacity = '1';
        e.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        obs.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold:0.04, rootMargin:'0px 0px -25px 0px' });

  document.querySelectorAll('.ifl-paso, .ifl-esp, .ifl-svc, .ifl-num-item, .ifl-feat, .ifl-manifest-col p').forEach(function(el, i){
    el.style.opacity = '0';
    el.style.transform = 'translateY(22px)';
    el.style.transition = 'opacity .62s ease ' + (i * 0.04) + 's, transform .65s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) ' + (i * 0.04) + 's';
    obs.observe(el);
  });

  /* ── Barras de temperatura al entrar en pantalla ── */
  var tempObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        var fills = e.target.querySelectorAll('.ifl-esp-temp-fill');
        fills.forEach(function(f){
          var w = f.getAttribute('data-width') || '75%';
          setTimeout(function(){ f.style.width = w; }, 200);
        });
        tempObs.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold:0.2 });

  document.querySelectorAll('.ifl-esp').forEach(function(v){ tempObs.observe(v); });

})();
</script>
